notes.title: Announcing release date: 29 October 2021!
notes.notes:
Finally, here we go!
One year has passed since the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/847560/Our_Hero_First/]Our Hero! First[/url], the first of a series of three games, planned to be developed and released in a three-year period.
Our Hero! Two is coming too, the [b]29th October 2021[/b]!

This second chapter improved a lot compared to its prequel. In Our Hero! Two you'll find:
- better graphics and animations
- a nicer game menu and title screen
- improved battle system
- two more heroes in your team, giving you a more variegated gameplay
- a lot of mini games
- upgradable weapons
- 9 new acts and brand new places to explore

It's been a long journey, but I hope you could appreciate this new adventure and the hard work behind this title as much as I enjoyed developing it.
Said this, stay tuned! I'll be posting more news very soon!
